**Direct coverage: `src/compose.ts` → `src/compose.test.ts`** (that's the only dedicated test file; 30 tests across 9 `describe` blocks).

Mapping the branches you'd be touching:

| `compose.ts` behavior | Test |
|---|---|
| middleware ordering / downstream-then-upstream | `compose` › Request / Response (`compose.test.ts:49,57`), `Compose` › "should get executed order one by one" (`:341`) |
| stops when a middleware skips `next()` | `:381` "should not get executed if previous next() not triggered" |
| `i <= index` → `next() called multiple times` | `:626` |
| `next` param (`i === middleware.length && next`) | `:574` "should compose w/ next", `:710` "should not get stuck on the passed in next" |
| `context.req.routeIndex = i` (Context branch) | Only indirectly — `src/request.test.ts` sets `routeIndex` by hand (`:54,71,116`) to test `param`/`routePath`; nothing in `compose.test.ts` asserts compose sets it |
| `onNotFound` (no handler, not finalized) | `:163,173` (sync + async handlers), plus `:311,325` for the not-finalized cases |
| `onError` catch, `context.error = err`, `isError` | `:243,266` (sync + async onError) |
| rethrow when not `Error` / no Context / no onError | `:499,583` (plain ctx object → rethrow), and `src/hono.test.ts:1392` throws a string through a real Context |
| `res && (finalized === false \|\| isError)` assignment | `:57`, `:138`, `:200` (401 overwrite), `:664` "should return last return value" |
| non-async handler returning a promise | `:68` describe block, `:461` |
| empty middleware array | `:480` |
| nested `compose` as a middleware | `:601`, `:640` |
| doesn't mutate input array | `:692` |

**Indirect coverage** (will also break if you regress compose):
- `src/hono.test.ts` — the big one; routing, `app.onError`/`app.notFound`, sub-app error propagation (`:1828`, `:1882`, `:2219`).
- `src/middleware/combine/index.test.ts` — `some`/`every`/`except` build on `compose` via `src/middleware/combine/index.ts:6`.

Run with `vitest --run src/compose.test.ts` for the fast loop; `npm test` runs `tsc --noEmit` + the full suite (coverage is on by default per `vitest.config.ts:14`).

One gap worth knowing before you edit: nothing asserts that compose assigns `context.req.routeIndex`, so a regression there would only surface through param/routePath behavior in `hono.test.ts`, if at all.
